description: drone-charlie's events are SUBMITTED in the order given by _submitOrder, but event 3's timestamp is ~10 minutes earlier than events already ingested. The reducer must fold it into its correct chronological position, not append it after the latest state.

events._comment: Arrives last (3rd submission) but its event_timestamp is before both prior events — ~10 minutes late per the PRD's example edge case.

expectedOutcomes.note: Latest state is unaffected (no conflict at any timestamp — single source throughout), but the audit trail / drone_state_versions history must show the late event inserted at 09:55, not appended after 10:10.
